reading: A Google-Calendar-style week view: a left sidebar (squiggle s0) holding a '+ Create' button, a mini month calendar with day-letter and date pills, and a 'My calendars' list with colored checkboxes; a top day-header row (squiggle s1 + border s4) listing MON 8 through SUN 14; a narrow hourly time-label column (squiggle s2) from 8AM to 9PM; a large striped week-grid body (box s3) with a red current-time line (s5) and several labeled event chips/buttons; and one detailed event card (box s6) for 'Sprint planning' with a 'Join call' button and guest info.
